game.notes: Feathers & bird shop: earn 1 feather per 10 pipes and buy birds (common 5, featured 10). Render resolution now relative to your screen (0.5x-2x). Big performance boost: pre-rendered bloom and film grain, faster effects. Android app asks for your screen's highest refresh rate.
